capabilities: Create custom task types with independent task collections
Move tasks across shared quadrants via drag-and-drop, keyboard, or batch selection
Search, archive, restore, sort, and batch-delete tasks
Generate Markdown mirrors for each task type and the archive
Persist board data locally through Obsidian's plugin data API
extras: No update checker, downloader, installer, or telemetry, and no runtime contact with GitHub or Gitee; board data and Markdown mirrors stay in the vault. Interface language: Follow Obsidian, Simplified Chinese, or English.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in board for grouping tasks by custom types across shared columns with archiving, search, and note mirrors.
summary: Lightweight Kanban task board with custom task types, shared quadrants, archives, search, and Markdown note mirrors.
